outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of red reflex assessment
cohort: 255 neonates born between July 2011 and March 2012 at Mustafa Hospital in Ilam city, Iran
finding: Red reflex examination by pediatricians is suggested for all neonates for early identification of ophthalmic problems.
mod_finding: 72.9% of neonates born by cesarean section had red reflex disorders compared to 56.8% of neonates born vaginally (P<0.007).
